data.prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical 2:3 Pinterest-native Arm A refrigerator reveal: an immaculate design-forward refrigerator opened at night, with exactly one five-inch translucent yellow-green molded-plastic Mystic Pickle fortune teller standing upright at the front of a clear vegetable drawer and a few ordinary cucumbers lying horizontally in soft focus. Preserve the strict product reference's gentle curve, rounded ends, raised bumps, and exactly one circular recessed answer-viewing window facing camera. Omit the purple box and wizard packaging. No real edible target pickle, glass, lamp, Magic 8 Ball, face, extra window, duplicate toy, readable labels or text, person, hand, logo, watermark, CTA, badge, price, border, collage, product-card frame, clutter, or branded containers.
notes: Full-resolution inspection shows one manufactured translucent toy, a single circular window, coherent refrigerator geometry, and three secondary out-of-focus cucumbers.
The visual misdirection is strong, but the food context makes the toy's fortune-teller purpose less immediately legible than the midnight execution.
